method: Production metadata scanner executed in Node VM with native Blob instances whose content accessors throw, asynchronous controlled IndexedDB cursors, transaction-completion/abort events and fault injection. The fixture does not implement metadata counting. The real generic owner is separately exercised using its established import fixture; after setup imports, content/hash access is made fatal and assertions compare only inspection activity with the completed setup baseline.
limitations: No real browser, device profile, persistent quota subsystem or audio hardware was exercised.
Quota observations are estimates; exact Blob sizes cover only the explicitly reported metadata scopes.

results.name: Loading and cached snapshots perform no storage reads, writes, quota query or audio work
Inspection counts native Blob sizes across personal, ambience and all retained recovery copies
Existing empty stores are measured zero; absent databases remain unknown and creation is aborted
Read errors are partial unknown values and preserve the last successful observation
Opening an inaccessible database never reports an empty successful source
Invalid personal payload is unavailable, never silently skipped as zero bytes
Quota estimates stay approximate and independent from exact Blob totals
Unsupported quota API does not turn observed recording metadata into missing data
Denied quota query preserves measured sources and exposes unavailable approximation
Pre-cancelled inspection does not open storage and never claims empty data
Cancellation aborts a held cursor and a late result cannot publish partial counts as successful
A connection version change cancels the source read and closes the old connection
Read deadline settles held storage as unavailable; late cursor completion stays retired
Newest request owns publication and replaces a held older inspection without overlapping transactions
A missing object store remains unknown without adding or repairing the store
Invalid ambience and malformed recovery copies cannot disappear from totals as zero
A store above the cursor row budget stops as unknown without allocating audio contents
More than 1000 retained recovery points stops honestly at the safety limit
Invalid generic owner summaries are unavailable rather than trusted as accurate counts
Untrusted quota ranges are unavailable and are never added to recording Blob bytes
Quota deadline retires its late estimate without replacing a newer cached observation
Late missing-database upgrade is aborted even after the requesting inspection was cancelled
Generic owner reports actual accessible stored Blobs while disabled without hashing or publishing a source
Generic metadata includes unlocked stored copies without enabling or mutating the live bank
Generic payload-size mismatch stays unavailable without changing archive status or starting audio verification
Generic orphan rows do not masquerade as a complete catalog
Generic absent database is unknown; an existing empty bank is an observed zero
Generic cancelled or stale ownership never opens a metadata transaction
Generic cancellation aborts a pending readonly transaction before delayed metadata can publish totals
A secret-access lock/unlock ABA invalidates an already pending generic metadata read
